name: Frozen V3 natural-agent bridge transfer execution

primary_positive.natural_retrieval: OFF coding agent independently executes a repository rg search whose actual search result contains historical-fix-adjacent production evidence
primary_positive.baseline: the evidence is outside the baseline high-relevance KEEP partition
primary_positive.counterfactual_v3: using the same search target and the OFF trajectory state available before that search, frozen V3 moves the same evidence into KEEP

raw_rg_limit: For automatic exact-output claims, use only an rg invocation whose agent-visible output can be reconstructed exactly. A wrapper capture before a downstream shell pipe is not by itself proof that every captured line reached the agent.
stopping_rule: run all 16 locked conditions; do not replace tasks or stop after a positive result
